items.title: Is Digital Realty Trust (DLR) Below Fair Value After Its AI Push?
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust has ridden a powerful three year run as investors focus on AI ready data centers, which raises a simple question for you as a shareholder or potential buyer. Is the current US$181.45 share price adequately backed by the cash flows the real estate investment trust is expected to generate? items.title: How Far Can Cipher Digital Stock Fall While It Waits For Rent?
items.summary: Cipher Digital (CIFR) stock fell 36.2% over the past three months. Over twelve months it is still up 54.1%, against 15.5% for the S&P 500. The company is moving from bitcoin mining to leasing data centers to hyperscale tenants. In past market shocks, the stock fell hard and bounced back fast.
